claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026 for his film One Battle After Another.
Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director win marked his first Oscar win in the category.
Paul Thomas Anderson had multiple nominations for Best Director prior to his win.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay on the same night as Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director win.
Chloé Zhao was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Hamnet.
Josh Safdie was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Marty Supreme.
Joachim Trier was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Sentimental Value.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
One Battle After Another earned six total awards at the 2026 Oscars.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another at the 2026 Oscars.
One Battle After Another won Best Editing at the 2026 Oscars.
One Battle After Another stars Leonardo DiCaprio
